text:
Kai: Helios wants a tightly scoped bench next Thu: steady 180 qps, p50 < 70ms, p99 < 300ms, plus two 30s bursts to 1.1k qps. Also validate cross-region failover us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 with failover < 60s. Need run plan, infra rec (Dedicated 5xA10G vs hybrid), and a 1-page summary + pricing delta. Can eng take this?

Noah: I can run it. Quick q: which model and token sizes? Cold vs warm checks?

Kai: Model = open-chat-7b-quant. Prompt ~130 tokens, gen ~70. They want both warm and cold failover checks.

Sana: Infra suggestion: primary Dedicated 5xA10G in us-east-1 + 2xA10G warm in eu-west-1 for failover. Hybrid option: 3xcommit + hosted bursts. Warm standby required to meet <60s RTO.

Noah: Short runbook:
- provision clusters: helios-use1-5gpu + helios-euw1-2warm
- prefix-warm 15m
- steady 180 qps for 90m for baseline
- inject two 30s bursts to 1100 qps at t+25m and t+55m
- failover test at t+80m: cut route -> shift to eu-west; measure failover time and p50/p99 recovery
- capture: p50/p90/p99, gpu_util, queue_len, tokens/sec, timeout/reject counts, and estimated cost/1M tokens

perf-bot: Suggested harness: ./bench --endpoint https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate --payload helios_template.json --qps 1100 --duration 30s (we orchestrate bursts as short jobs).

Noah: Expectations: steady 180 qps -> batching gives good p50 (~55-65ms). Bursts will increase queueing; if avg queue_len > 160 during bursts add 1 GPU or enable aggressive batching. Cold failover without warm standby will exceed 60s due to image/model init.

Sana: Commercial ballpark: Dedicated 5xA10G commit ~ "$95k/mo". Hybrid (3xcommit + bursts) likely ~15-30% premium on heavy-burst months; will refine after tokens/sec/GPU measured. Include a "commercial mapping" section in the writeup translating effective tokens/sec per GPU to monthly spend under both models.

Kai: Please run a quick smoke tonight and schedule the full run Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic). Draft 1-pager + spreadsheet by Thu EOD. Also add a short security blurb for the questionnaire about logs/PII.

Sana: Security blurb: "Request payloads are redacted at the edge by default. Operational logs retain anonymized request IDs, routing and latency metadata. Default retention: metrics 30 days, request traces 7 days. For full separation, Private deployment with customer-managed KMS and isolated log sinks is available."

Noah: Running smoke now. Will post perf dashboard link and artifacts in this thread after the run.

Kai: Thanks team  drop artifacts + dashboard here. :rocket:
